claims.claim: The 2026 Silver Maple Leaf bullion coin is one troy ounce, 99.99% fine, 38 mm in diameter, and has a C$5 face value.
The American Silver Eagle bullion coin is one troy ounce of 99.9% silver, 40.60 mm in diameter, and has a US$1 face value.
The Royal Canadian Mint and U.S. Mint publish different security details for their respective coin programs.
The U.S. Mint distributes bullion coins through authorized purchasers and describes pricing as market price plus a premium.
